prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a vibrant botanical greenhouse filled with lush greenery and diverse visitors. On the far left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands holding a small trowel, her gaze fixed on a potted fern beside her. Next to her sits a wooden bench where an elderly man in a blue cap rests his hands on his knees, observing the scene. A brown dog lies calmly at the feet of the man in the blue cap, its head resting on the floorboards. In the center foreground, a child in striped socks points excitedly at a large pitcher plant, drawing the attention of a teacher in glasses who leans down to look at the same plant. The teacher holds a clipboard against their chest while smiling gently. Behind them, a gardener in overalls waters a hanging basket of orchids, the water droplets visible in mid-air. To the right of the gardener, a teenager in a hoodie sketches in a notebook, sitting cross-legged on the ground. A black cat perches on a nearby shelf, watching the teenager with bright eyes. Further back on the right, a couple shares an umbrella; the person in the red dress looks up at the glass ceiling while the person in the gray suit holds the umbrella handle firmly. A parrot with colorful feathers sits on a perch near the couple, tilting its head curiously. In the background, a scientist in a white coat examines a leaf through a magnifying glass, standing next to a tall palm tree. A butterfly flutters near the scientist's shoulder, adding movement to the stillness. There is no electronic screen visible anywhere in the scene. There is no concrete wall surrounding the garden, only glass panels.
